ADB Warns of Sustained Inflation Pressure in Asia Until 2027

The Asian Development Bank (ADB) has warned that Asia will face sustained inflation pressure into 2027. The bank cited ongoing wars in Europe and the Middle East, along with a severe El Nino, as factors amplifying price pressures across the continent.
